svg.title: DEMO paired performance–bandwidth tradeoff across three batches
svg.desc: All plotted numbers are simulated, not measured. Three batches, five independent devices each, with before and after endpoints. Layer schematic is not to scale. Carrier transfer rate is unmeasured.
